execution.precheck: Use test-execution pre_build_check with explicit non-root container user before each invocation.
execution.isolation: Distinct output_user_root per worktree and dependency lane. Keep canonical GPU locks.
execution.config: Use cuda13+repo_env1 OR cuda13_sm90, never redundantly expand both.
artifacts: paired source SHAs and dirty state
test.xml with nonzero passed test bodies
execution.scope: This matrix is source inventory, not Bazel query, execution evidence or model precision certification.

coverage_limits: Official standalone DP8 decode uses synthetic KV; it is not realPD or semantic/acceptance coverage.
Two-kernel fused HC boundary max64 and standalone prenorm max256 are separate contracts.
The 24-layer golden requires its exact checkpoint; never use it with full40 release weights.

CP4/DP4 full40 ordinary and DSpark startup OOM on the tested 80GiB-class L20Z container; those targets are diagnostic only here. Required release semantics/realPD use the two-node CP8/DP8 workflow, with separate actual transport evidence; no PASS is implied.

Complete timing measurements before timeline collection; derive rank coverage from actual process/rank/device trace metadata. Nov20 standalone DP8 perf observed54 distinct traces covering all8DP; selected6rank0 files are representatives.
No acceptance or latency threshold is invented from short correctness cases.
Production scale/gate/inputpack/commit tests are core; alternative experimental backends and tuning sweeps are excluded.
